title: The Pressure's Deepest Apprentice

features.name: the first apprenticeship
features.desc-on-touch: A chip embedded deep in the circuit, warm to the touch. The pressure taught it to yield instead of break. Its silicon holds the memory of learning gentleness.

features.name: the pressure's hands
features.desc-on-touch: Fingers of carved stone press the circuit without crushing it. The pressure learned where to touch so that breaking becomes shaping. You feel the care in the geometry.

features.name: the trace of learning
features.desc-on-touch: Pathways in the board show where the pressure flowed while learning. Each path is a day of understanding. The deepest groove is where it learned that power is not force.

features.name: the surgical moment
features.desc-on-touch: A moment frozen: pressure and earth meeting at the exact depth where tenderness becomes possible. The stone glows faintly. This is where the earth taught itself to caress.

inscription: the apprentice learned that its master was not force but the choice to soften

reverie.title: REVERIE — pressure learning gentleness in deep water
narr: You waded with Katita into the creek where pressure had
carved the stone smooth over centuries. 'The water doesn't
fight,' she said, her hand on the dark rock. 'It just asks
the stone over and over: soften? Soften? And the stone says yes.'
You felt the current around your legs and understood: the deepest
power was patience learning to caress what resisted it.
